# AI Made A Lot Of "Hideous" Code But Found Major Bottlenecks For Faster Linux Compilation

> "An LLM was used to first determine where the bottlenecks were then to figure out how to improve them. It generated a lot of code, much of it hideous. I extensively audited and rewrote a lot of it, and heavily edited commit messages, the cover letter and comments.x The LLM has also orchestrated build runs, testing, debugging and analysis. I have manually checked for correctness in both build and running kernels generated with this series applied. Performance improvements were also verified manually. Since an LLM was used extensively, each commit carries an Assisted-by tag."
